verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents an official cross-platform CLI that manages flags and other resources from the command line. It also documents scoped API access tokens suited to programmatic integrations, and markets connecting CI/CD pipelines. However, the evidence never explicitly shows headless or non-interactive CLI use inside a CI job, so the core is plausible but not fully evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running the CLI or API non-interactively in CI pipelines (token-based auth in CI, official CI actions or examples), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
